id: 06_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Incident or Near Miss Scenario
title: 是事故还是未遂
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/06_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Incident or Near Miss Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/06_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Incident or Near Miss Scenario/src.py

points.K6: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室里，两手各举一张卡片：一张有感叹号，一张有半个感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory holding two blank cards, one with a full exclamation mark icon and one with a faded exclamation mark icon.
shots.narration: 这一课是个判断题：事故还是未遂？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 听完故事，请你来做判断。

shots.scene: 老周穿防护服、戴手套，站在动物实验台旁，旁边是简化的猴子图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man, an animal care technician in a gown and gloves, stands beside a padded table with a simple cartoon monkey icon on it.
shots.narration: 一位动物饲养技术员正在工作。

shots.scene: 老周手持注射器，靠近猴子图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a syringe and leans toward the simple cartoon monkey icon on the table.
shots.narration: 他在给一只非人灵长类动物注射。

shots.scene: 注射器图标和针头图标分开，中间有断开符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe body separated from its needle, with a small break symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 注射完，针头和注射器脱开了。

shots.scene: 简化的猴子图标手臂上插着一枚小针头
shots.prompt_en: A simple cartoon monkey icon with a tiny needle icon left in its arm. No people.
shots.narration: 针头还留在动物的皮肤里。

shots.scene: 老周手里只剩注射器，愣了一下
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at the syringe in his hand, now without a needle, with a surprised face.
shots.narration: 手里只剩下了注射器。

shots.scene: 老周用手把针头从猴子图标上取下
shots.prompt_en: The older man pulls the small needle off the simple cartoon monkey icon with his gloved fingers.
shots.narration: 技术员把针头从动物身上取了下来。

shots.scene: 老周一手捏针头，一手拿注射器，对准要接回去
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds the loose needle in one gloved hand and the syringe in the other, lining them up to reconnect them.
shots.narration: 接着，他想把注射器重新接回针头上。

shots.scene: 不远处的台面上放着一个黄色锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: A yellow sharps container sits on a bench a short distance away. No people.
shots.narration: 这样就能一起丢进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 老周的手指被针尖碰到，冒出一个小红点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the older man's gloved fingertip touched by the needle tip, with a tiny red dot and a small spark of pain.
shots.narration: 就在这时，针头扎到了他的手指。

shots.scene: 老周捂着手指，表情吃痛
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds his finger with a pained expression, the syringe on the table.
shots.narration: 针，扎进了手指里。

shots.scene: 欣欣在两张卡片之间来回看，头顶一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks back and forth between the two blank cards, a question mark above its head.
shots.narration: 问题来了：这算一起事故，

shots.scene: 两张卡片并排，中间是一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: The two blank cards side by side with a large question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 还是一起未遂事件？

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 把故事从头到尾，再回想一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白本子上写写画画
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot writes in a blank notebook, thinking hard.
shots.narration: 写下你的判断，还有你的理由。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现注射器和猴子图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a syringe and a simple monkey.
shots.narration: 给动物注射，针头脱落在皮肤里。

shots.scene: 针头和注射器对接的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a needle and a syringe being lined up to reconnect. No people.
shots.narration: 取下针头，想接回注射器一起丢。

shots.scene: 手指上一个小红点的图标
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon with a tiny red dot. No people.
shots.narration: 结果，针头扎到了手指。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 事故还是未遂？留给你判断。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着两张卡片向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds the two blank cards and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 想好你的答案，下次见！
